incremental_prs.title: [Cell research 4/5] Exercise trained GRU/CfC/diagonal kernels through one HIA image
incremental_prs.body:
## Problem

An alternate temporal kernel must first use the same real Cell owner, native HIA interface, training/checkpoint path and cold recovery boundaries before an E07 kernel comparison can be admitted.

## Change

Add a source-bound engineering probe that derives immutable GRU, CfC and diagonal-kernel candidates from one common HIA/compiler/device family. For MEM and PRED it performs eight actual Adam updates on disclosed fixture episodes, retains per-attempt training costs/failures, then executes the trained kernels through the actual native HIA image in fresh worker processes. It checks trained logits, exact cold receipt replay, new cold inference, durable state and specific changed-request rejection. Model and optimizer checkpoint hashes are checked independently.

Observe actual enqueue/start/final-receipt task boundaries with the prior stage's ledger. Preserve per-call originals and a copied request in each summary; retain partial training/build failures instead of publishing incomplete success summaries.

Extend the existing CI to run the local native probe and each derived candidate through the same built hepta-runtime source/binary with cold original-job observation.

## Validation and boundaries

Two targeted failure-accounting controls passed before pinned formatting. Real native/cold execution is now running against this exact published source and the CI records will carry its results.

This is an engineering interface probe: the episodes are synthetic/disclosed, the kernel sizes are explicitly unmatched, there are no new independent source groups and no qualified Adopt. It does not claim E07 comparative benefit, HCSN integration or full cost. The original ten research execution/result nulls remain unchanged.

Depends on #6617. Keep Draft; no merge or production adoption.

incremental_prs.title: [Cell research 3/5] Bind paired group statistics to a frozen comparison family
incremental_prs.body:
## Problem

Repeated seeds or transformed examples cannot increase the independent sample size. Missing pairs, optional stopping and uncharged candidate attempts must not produce a research gain claim.

## Change

Add an explicit statistical sub-plan with candidate/control digests, group/seed/repeat schedules, phase, metric, meaningful-gain margin, alpha, precision rationale and a complete fixed comparison family. Analysis requires the externally retained plan SHA. Scores are paired within each source group, then group means receive equal weight. Hoeffding one-sided bounds and Bonferroni correction charge the entire declared family, including failed/unrun slots.

Reject duplicate/unscheduled pairs, changed plan digests, NaN/infinite/bool scores and optional stopping. Any missing planned pair returns a null confidence bound. The helper never asserts source independence, authenticates freeze timing, tracks actual compute budgets or accepts a research claim; full P04 commitments and access custody remain external gates.

## Validation

Five behavioral tests passed before pinned formatting. Tests cover repeated-seed sample inflation, incomplete group/seed/repeat schedules, frozen-family accounting, malformed scores and post-freeze changes. Added to the existing actual-head Cell/HIA workflow.

## Stack and scope

Depends on #6616. The original ten experiment results remain null. No historical data is reclassified as a held-out study. Keep Draft; no merge or production adoption.

incremental_prs.title: [Cell research 2/5] Observe enqueue through durable final receipt
incremental_prs.body:
## Problem

Component windows cannot establish whole-task latency, queue occupancy or complete planned denominators. A lost final receipt must stay missing instead of becoming zero cost or triggering a second dispatch.

## Change

Add a bounded final-receipt reader and SQLite task observation ledger with a frozen candidate, explicit monotonic clock identity and task/Cell/arm/phase/source plan. Record actual enqueue, start, interruption and final readback boundaries. Keep unsubmitted/pending tasks in denominators; serialize competing starts; reject replacement terminal identities and changed/missing retained receipt bytes. A runner exception is re-raised and remains pending.

Report scoped queue occupancy and whole-task distributions with observed/missing/planned counts. Energy, exact campaign process-tree memory and independent external business effects remain null. The ledger does not authorize actions or qualify full-system cost.

## Validation

Six isolated behavioral tests passed, including real subprocess failure, process exit before dispatch, concurrent starts, cold readback and terminal-byte conflict/missing evidence. A retained engineering smoke recorded planned=3, accepted=2, started=2, final=1, pending=1, unsubmitted=1 and scoped queue peak=2. No independent research groups were created.

The Python 3.10 exception path now guards the optional add_note API. The existing Cell/HIA workflow runs this module's tests on the actual published source.

## Stack and scope

Depends on #6615. This is one cohesive observer/runner/test stage. E03/E09/E10 acceptance stays open; original experiment execution/result nulls, deterministic baseline, learning gates and migration refusal are unchanged. Keep Draft; no production adoption or merge.

incremental_prs.title: [Cell research 1/5] Check source dependence and held-out exposure before experiments
incremental_prs.body:
## Problem

The ten research acceptance specifications require independent source groups and sealed evaluation tasks. Counting transformed tasks, repeated seeds or exposed historical repairs as new held-out groups would invalidate E01/E02/E05/E08/E09.

## Change

Add a metadata-only source admission check that joins original events, reviewed root-cause families, parent lineage, duplicate task bytes and templates; rejects dependencies crossing A/B/C/D/retention; and retains missing chronology, commitments and source authority as blockers. It never reads held-out task/oracle bytes or authorizes a study. A valid metadata result still leaves independently authenticated source-group count unknown.

Add eight behavioral tests and include them in the existing Cell/HIA CI controls. This is the first small stage, based exactly on the user's evidence/specification commit 232a0807dc71c32215154f1248898a86a844e1b3.

## Evidence and scope

Eight isolated CPU behavioral tests passed before repository-pinned formatting. `just fmt --base 232a0807dc71c32215154f1248898a86a844e1b3` completed locally. Current-head CI will provide assembled validation.

The existing historical corpus contains five real replay tasks in three dependent source groups, with exposed gold patches/oracles; it remains development/regression evidence. New qualified unseen groups and accepted research comparisons remain zero. The original ten experiment execution/result fields are unchanged and null.

Keep Draft. No merge, production adoption, weakened deterministic baseline, or in-flight migration activation is requested.
